Ecosystem Partners

GenLayer isn't building in isolation. The Portal now showcases the full ecosystem in one place — partners, validators, and high-signal projects all visible and organized for the first time.

This is a rapidly expanding network of infrastructure, AI, DeFi, analytics, and compute partners helping power trustless adjudication — GenLayer's core innovation. The ecosystem exists to support one thing: AI consensus, Intelligent Contracts, and subjective on-chain decisions.

"The GenLayer ecosystem in one place: Partners, validators, and featured high-signal projects."

  • Active validators
  • Featured projects
  • Infrastructure layer

Why it matters

  • High-signal projects surfaced
  • One coordination point

Feature 02 of 06
Metrics Dashboard

This is one of the most important features on the Portal. GenLayer's architecture is radically different from normal blockchains because validators use LLMs and live web access during execution. That means monitoring infrastructure becomes critical.

The Metrics Dashboard exposes deep validator and network telemetry. It's not vanity metrics. This is infrastructure-level transparency — the observability layer for decentralized AI reasoning.

"A live read on where GenLayer stands, in real numbers. Not just activity — actual network health."

Three tabs

  • Portal metrics
  • Network metrics
  • Community metrics

What's tracked

  • Validators + builders
  • Review flows
  • Studio + testnets
  • Repos + social channels

This is where GenLayer starts looking extremely intriguing. The Portal acts as a full onboarding hub for developers building Intelligent Contracts — and GenLayer's approach is very different from Solidity ecosystems.

This is the actual starting point if you want to build on GenLayer. Docs, tooling, examples, and the complete path from idea to deployed Intelligent Contract — all in one place.

GenNews + GenTV

Most ecosystems struggle with fragmented information. Updates scattered across Discord, posts lost on X, content buried in threads. GenNews and GenTV are designed to fix that.

This turns the Portal from a static website into a living ecosystem interface — a native media layer where builders get visibility, launches stay discoverable, educational content compounds, and community activity stays transparent.

Feature 05 of 06
Community POAPs

GenLayer cleverly turns participation into on-chain reputation. Every GenLayer POAP is now issued and collected directly on the Portal. Past mints are already loaded on your profile — nothing lost, everything organized.

Inside GenLayer's ecosystem, this goes deeper than just collectibles. POAP integrations help track event participation, community contributions, and ecosystem engagement — building a verifiable reputation layer for every community member.

"Every GenLayer POAP will be issued and collected on the GenLayer Portal. Past mints already loaded on your profile."

What's tracked

  • Event participation
  • Community contributions
  • Ecosystem engagement
  • Historical mint records

Portal features

  • Organized by month
  • Past mints auto-loaded
  • Search POAPs
  • Recover lost POAPs

How to claim your AMA POAP

01
Go to the Portal

Visit portal.genlayer.foundation/#/community/poaps

02
Click the live POAP

Select the POAP for today's event from the list

03
Listen for the secret phrase

Usually dropped after the first 20 minutes of the AMA

04
Enter and claim

Type the phrase and click Claim. Done.

📝 Note on secret phrases: Phrases no longer use dashes. Spaces are now used instead.
Previously: poap-mint-test → Now: poap mint test
